title: Editor Canvas Text Descendant Selection Checklist

items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor, Backend, and Core boundary context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, Work path, owner repository, terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, and the bounded canvas text descendant selection target are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor with bounded repo-backend/repo-core references, phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-canvas-text-descendant-selection, checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-canvas-text-descendant-selection, and evidence target evidence-editor-canvas-text-descendant-selection-2026-08-31 before edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor tests before changing preview text descendant selection behavior.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests fail before canvas preview child text can select the exact editable text-block descendant, before PaperBlock exposes text descendant hit markers, and before the hit-test helper recognizes those markers.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included commands failure where canvas-text-descendant selection still normalized summary-left-text to summary-columns, paperTextBlockEditor failure for missing data-canvas-text-descendant-id, and selectionHitTest failure before hitTestCanvasTextDescendantTarget existed.

items.label: Expose selection-only hit markers for represented preview text descendants.
items.evidenceTarget: PaperBlock marks composite preview text cells with data-canvas-text-descendant-id for editableTextDescendants without turning those descendants into independent renderable paper blocks.
items.verificationNote: PaperBlock now derives descendant ids from editableTextDescendants by represented preview text order and adds data-canvas-text-descendant-id such as summary-left-text while preserving the owning surface data-node-id.

items.label: Preserve exact child selection for canvas text descendant clicks while keeping canvas operations surface-based.
items.evidenceTarget: PaperPageStack detects canvas text descendant targets before ordinary canvas hit testing, routes selection through source canvas-text-descendant, and keeps pointer drag/reorder surface-based.
items.verificationNote: resolveEditorSelectionTargetForSource preserves exact editable text-block ids for outline and canvas-text-descendant sources, while ordinary canvas still resolves internal ids to the owning operation surface.

items.label: Prevent canvas text descendant selection from becoming a Backend mutation source.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend mutation request and add-node contract source types exclude canvas-text-descendant, and runtime request building rejects accidental use.
items.verificationNote: EditorMutationCommandSource excludes canvas-text-descendant, add-node contracts use mutation-safe command sources, and backendMutationRequests rejects canvas-text-descendant with a dedicated error reason.

items.label: Prove preview child selection and Outline highlight through a live local Backend browser smoke.
items.evidenceTarget: The browser smoke clicks a canvas preview text descendant, verifies selectedOutlineNodeIds contains the child id, reloads from live Backend, and verifies the same child id remains the selected Outline item.
items.verificationNote: The retained smoke records selectionMethod canvas-text-descendant-preview, previewHitTargetPresent true, selectedOutlineNodeIds [summary-left-text], reloadedSelectedOutlineNodeIds [summary-left-text], then continues the existing live Backend reorder proof.

items.label: Run worktree and merged-main Editor gates and record cleanup state honestly.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor worktree and merged main pass focused tests, full check, and no-write live Backend browser smoke; cleanup risks remain explicit.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree passed focused tests, type-check, live Backend browser smoke, and npm run check with 102 test files and 362 tests plus build.
